description: This file defines the RPC client and server implementations for Mattermost plugin communication, including hook and API interfaces, error handling, and streaming mechanisms using go-plugin and net/rpc.

classes.name: hooksRPCClient
classes.description: Client-side RPC proxy for plugin hooks and API calls, manages RPC communication, streaming, and method forwarding.

classes.name: hooksRPCServer
classes.description: Server-side RPC handler that receives requests from the client proxy and delegates to plugin implementation.

classes.name: hooksPlugin
classes.description: Implements hashicorp/go-plugin.Plugin interface to connect plugin hooks and API implementations.

classes.name: ErrorString
classes.description: Fallback error type for RPC communication, encapsulates error message and code.

methods.name: encodableError
methods.description: Converts standard errors into encodable error types for RPC transmission.

methods.name: decodableError
methods.description: Converts encodable RPC errors back into standard error types.

methods.name: Server
methods.description: Returns the RPC server implementation for hooks plugin.

methods.name: Client
methods.description: Creates the RPC client proxy for hooks plugin.

methods.name: OnActivate
methods.description: Establishes RPC connections and initializes plugin activation.

methods.name: LoadPluginConfiguration
methods.description: Loads plugin configuration via RPC.

methods.name: ServeHTTP
methods.description: Handles RPC streaming of HTTP requests and responses between server and plugin.

methods.name: PluginHTTP
methods.description: Buffered version of plugin HTTP request handling.

methods.name: PluginHTTPStream
methods.description: Streaming version of plugin HTTP request handling using MuxBroker.

methods.name: FileWillBeUploaded
methods.description: RPC method for handling file upload streams.

methods.name: MessageWillBePosted
methods.description: RPC method invoked before a message is posted.

methods.name: MessageWillBeUpdated
methods.description: RPC method invoked before a message is updated.

methods.name: MessagesWillBeConsumed
methods.description: RPC method invoked when multiple messages are consumed.

methods.name: LogDebug
methods.description: RPC method for debug logging.

methods.name: LogInfo
methods.description: RPC method for info logging.

methods.name: LogWarn
methods.description: RPC method for warning logging.

methods.name: LogError
methods.description: RPC method for error logging.

methods.name: LogAuditRec
methods.description: RPC method for logging audit records.

methods.name: LogAuditRecWithLevel
methods.description: RPC method for logging audit records with severity level.

methods.name: InstallPlugin
methods.description: RPC method for uploading and installing a plugin.

methods.name: UploadData
methods.description: RPC method for uploading data streams.

methods.name: ServeMetrics
methods.description: RPC method for serving metrics via HTTP streaming.
